work_unit: Diagnose and restore local OpenAI OCR runtime connectivity

execution.reason: The investigation was one connected local runtime issue; a separate worker would not create an independent verification path.

evidence.settings_probe: The running configuration has an OpenAI key, model gpt-4.1-mini, and a 45-second OCR timeout. No secret value was inspected or logged.
evidence.provider_probe: A document-free Responses API request completed with the configured key and model.
evidence.cause: The local FastAPI process serving port 8000 had been launched in a restricted runtime and could not reach the OpenAI API. The application correctly converted its upstream failure into the intentionally sanitized OCR_PROVIDER_ERROR envelope.
evidence.remediation: Stopped only the identified local backend launcher and child process, then restarted the same uvicorn application outside the restricted runtime.
evidence.live_verification: Health returned 200. A supplied fictional licence image completed upload (201), OCR reading (200, one nonempty OCR page), and private cleanup (204). No document text or access capability was recorded.

outcome.user_action: Retry the failed read in the browser; failed reads do not publish partial results.
